name: stage_1_stand_symmetric
description: Stand to a symmetric base first (E1b fr_blend on, homeo OFF), advance at ~80s.  The per-tick brain forms the dynamically-stable stance before the per-step walking signal turns on.

name: stage_2_homeokinetic_walk_phase_coupled
description: (c) homeo_b + CROSS-LEG PHASE-CONSISTENCY COUPLING (reward-space inter-leg coordination).  homeo_b proved genuine per-leg knee cycling (autocorr 0.61-0.86 all seeds) but legs step at independent rates (diag_coherence ~0) with seed-dependent quality (s42 controlled vs s123/126 over-swing).  homeo_phase_couple=1 scales each touchdown's payout by the consistency of its relative phase against the other legs' cycles (per-pair circular EMA, neutral until structure exists).  ANY stable phase relation pays — no gait is imposed; incoherent stepping is taxed.  Prediction: homeo_phase_R rises over the run, diag_coherence leaves ~0, the over-swing variance collapses, clean_gait beats homeo_b's 0.099.
